chitchat: Raven walks once round the resurfacer, kicking each tyre.
He fills the wash-water tank from a hose and watches the gauge.
He scrapes a ridge of snow off the conditioner into a bucket.
He wipes down the blade with a rag.
He hums a Marauders chant under his breath.
description: A lean man in his fifties in a navy ice-crew parka, RAVEN stencilled across the back and a navy-and-silver Marauders scarf tucked in at the collar. A respirator hangs round his neck on a cracked strap. He's wiping down the resurfacer's blade with a rag.

broadcast.text: "Yeah, they show me sped up between periods. I look ridiculous."

crows.text: "Crows. With a name like mine, I didn't really get a choice."

cup.text: He grins. "Final night they let me paint her. Purple and gold, my name down both sides. Best night of the year."

fuel.text: "No idea, honestly. It comes in that drum. I just wear the mask."

machine.text: "Yep. The league's only got the one, so I take her to every game."

pattern.text: "Big loops, and you overlap each pass a bit so you don't leave lines. Takes about five minutes."

options.label: How do you do the ice?
Do they show you on the broadcast?
People say the ice is slush.
Does she get dressed up for the Cup?

root.text: "Hey. Mind the ice, it's still wet."

text_by_relation.first:
The man by the resurfacer looks up.

"Hi. I'm Ken, I drive the Zamboni."

slush.text: "Yeah, well, they can try doing it with the stuff I get." He shrugs. "It's good ice. I'm proud of it."

team.text: "Marauders!" He pulls a navy-and-silver scarf out of his collar. "Best team in the league, don't let anyone tell you different."

canvas work trousers and cleated rubber boots

name: Ken Raven
